$comment: Advisories consciously accepted, each with a deadline. See security/README.md. Entries appear only when pnpm audit actually reports something the build cannot fix.

accepted.reason: No patched release exists: the advisory records `patched_versions: <0.0.0` against a vulnerable range of `<=2.0.1`, and 2.0.1 is the latest published version, so there is nothing to upgrade to. Reached only as .>@lhci/cli>lighthouse>puppeteer-core>@puppeteer/browsers>extract-zip — a devDependency that runs in CI, never in shipped application code. The vulnerability requires extracting an attacker-supplied archive (CVSS 3.1 vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N, per the advisory record); the only archive this path extracts is the Chrome build that @puppeteer/browsers downloads from Google's CDN over HTTPS. Named risk area: supply chain. Re-check at the deadline: drop this entry the moment extract-zip publishes a fix, or if Lighthouse CI is removed.
